findings.current: And Dark Heaven’s army had them beaten on both counts.
findings.defect: The source says Dark Heaven’s forces overwhelmed the allies in every respect. “On both counts” limits that claim to the two factors just named.
findings.rationale: The source says 현재 암천의 군세는 모든 면에서 아군을 압도하고 있었다 (“Dark Heaven’s forces were overwhelming their allies in every respect”). The accepted baseline also preserved “in every way.”
findings.replacement: In that regard, Dark Heaven’s army outclassed their own in every respect.

findings.current:
But the Black Night King, Sima Gong, had not known.

That a young man whom a cold-hearted father had sent to his death would save his son.
findings.defect: The source adds that no one else could have known either. That emphasis is missing.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly follows “Sima Gong had not known” with “No, no one would have known” (아니, 그 누구도 몰랐을 것이다). The accepted baseline preserved this emphasis.
findings.replacement:
But the Black Night King, Sima Gong, had not known.

No—no one could have known.

That a young man whom a cold-hearted father had sent to his death would save his son.

findings.current: Why hadn’t the enemy targeted it?
findings.defect: The source asks why the Black Ghosts had not targeted this place, while “it” can refer to Sima Gong’s army in the preceding sentence.
findings.rationale: The source’s 이곳 (“this place”) refers to the location under discussion, and the preceding question identifies the Black Ghosts as the subject.
findings.replacement: Why hadn’t they targeted this place?

summary: The chapter is largely faithful, but the assembled copy narrows one explicit comparison and omits a narrative emphasis.
